title: Multiply the published C5 weights into the floors 45 and 561/16
body:
## Summary
- The integer lifts `2, 8, 1, 7, 2, 3, 3, 4, 6` sum to 36, so the weights sum to `36/16 = 9/4`. With local floor 20 this gives `20 · 9/4 = 45`.
- The full-support total `303/16` exceeds 9 by `159/16`, so one J term lowers the floor to `45 − 159/16 = 561/16`.
- Both floors are greater than `180/7`. The diagonal tariff `112 · 2 = 224` meets 45, and the J-extension tariff `9 + 16088 = 16097` meets `561/16`. Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change.
